_note: clients-preferred-name. The name a person asks to be called by (roepnaam). Held on the contact person and on a client that is a person, synced both ways with the Nextcloud contact as the vCard NICKNAME, and used where pipelinq addresses the person. Nothing derives it from the full name: a preferred name is something a person states. The vCard property is NICKNAME; a client that is an organisation carries none.

preferredName.title: Preferred name
preferredName.description: The name this person likes to be called, such as Jan for Johannes.
